text:
ops-alert-bot: :warning: ALERT: us-west GPU pool 'gpu-pool-a' admission control firing heavily, request queueing > 95th pct threshold. Several downstream services returning 502/503. @oncall notified

maria: I'm opening a postmortem thread — can folks paste initial observations here?

ben: saw this spike ~08:12 UTC, GPU queue depth jumped from ~40->220 over 3min. autoscale didn't add nodes due to quota errors.

ashley: confirmed, autoscaler logs: 
```
E0509 08:13:12  PID: autoscaler: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded -> "InsufficientQuota: Requested 4 GPUs, available 0"
```

ashley: so admission control started rejecting/rate-limiting. A bunch of batch indexing jobs were retried and saturated the queue.

maria: any network flakiness or NLB errors?

ben: NLB healthy. No 5xx at LB. It's internal scheduling + quota + sudden burst from nightly reruns of a customer eval job.

sam: we saw a job storm from workspace 'acme-ml' at 08:10 — their job retried on timeouts and spawned many small jobs (~150) that pinned GPU slots.

olivia: impact: hosted API calls in us-west saw 95p latency go from 120ms->2.4s and 10% 503s for 6 minutes. Dedicated customers saw degraded throughput but SLA remained because fallback to reserved capacity in other zones happened for some routes.

maria: timeline so far (short):
- 08:10 UTC: acme-ml job retries begin
- 08:12 UTC: gpu-pool-a queue crosses admission threshold
- 08:13 UTC: autoscaler fails due to quotaExceeded
- 08:14-08:20 UTC: admission control hard-limits requests, cascade: batch controller retries -> more job submissions -> queue grows
- 08:21 UTC: manual mitigation: scale-up with emergency quota bump and move some routes to gpu-pool-b
- 08:25 UTC: queues return to normal

ben: root cause hypothesis: combination of (1) noisy customer job that retries aggressively, (2) autoscaler unable to provision due to cloud quota limits, (3) admission control thresholds too strict/thresholds not adaptive to sudden burst leading to backpressure loop.

ashley: additional contributing factor: our batch job controller aggressively retries on transient errors without jitter/backoff; that amplified the retry storm.

sam: logs show ~60% of queued requests were from the same workspace and had identical model version and short TTL. Could've benefited from prefix-caching or dedupe.

olivia: cost/ops note: emergency quota bump added ~8 GPUs for 30m. Cost hit ~+$120 for that window, but avoided longer SLA impact.

maria: mitigation checklist (short-term):
- add jittered exponential backoff to batch controller retries (ashley)
- loosen admission control hard-limit to allow small graceful degradation in latency instead of immediate 503s (ben)
- implement per-workspace submission rate cap for batch jobs (sam)
- add quota preflight in autoscaler and fallback path to burst pool in other region before failing (tomas)

ben: longer-term actions:
- autoscaler: surface quota shortfalls to SRE alerting earlier + automatic fallback strategies (cross-region spill)
- admission control: make thresholds adaptive based on observed burst patterns + add telemetry that shows which workspace triggered backpressure
- evaluate adding a small hot spare GPU pool for burst absorb (cost tradeoff)

maria: action owners and ETA:
- ashley: batch-controller retry patch -> PR by EOD + staging deploy tomorrow
- ben: admission control tuning + dashboard -> draft by 3 days
- sam: per-workspace rate limiter design -> proposal by 1 week
- tomas: autoscaler quota check + fallback -> initial MR in 2 weeks

olivia: communication: we should send an incident summary to affected customers. I'll draft a short note and loop in CS.

maria: postmortem writeup: I'll assemble timeline + root cause + actions. Assigning to this thread for tracking. Please add any logs/queries you used.

ben: queries I ran: 
```
# gpu queue depth by pool
sum(gpu_queue_depth) by (gpu_pool) where region="us-west-2" | last_5m
# top submitters
topk(10, sum(rate(batch_submissions_total[1m])) by (workspace))
```

ashley: I'll add autoscaler logs and the quota error traces to the doc.

sam: I'll reach out to acme-ml and recommend changing retry policy; we should consider temp sandboxing heavy batch workloads.

maria: OK — closing immediate on-call loop. We'll convert this thread into a formal postmortem doc and tag it once complete. Thanks all :handshake:

ops-alert-bot: Incident resolved at 08:25 UTC — gpu-pool-a queue depth back to baseline.
